messages:
incident-bot: URGENT: 429 spike detected for customer "Ridgeway Inc" in vpc-pool-ridgeway-01. 1m rate > 5x baseline, ~90% error responses 429. Severity: high. Paging oncall: @Sasha M. Link: https://incidents.redwood/1918765432
Sasha M: on it. grabbing pool and tenant metrics now. @Priya R can you stand by for contract override if we need a quick unthrottle?
Priya R: here. if we need a temporary bump we can push an emergency override tied to their commitment. need confirmation on tenant isolation and expected duration.
Charlie W: looking at the dedicated pool — token-bucket is exhausted for their tenant, burst credits = 0. KV cache hit-rate dropped to 7%. QPS jumped 120 -> 760 in last 10m.
Lee T: saw a surge of long-context completions from a small set of callers. could be a customer regression (mass replays). pinged Ridgeway in support channel.
Ridgeway Support: Ridgeway SRE here — confirmed a batch job kicked at 07:18 UTC, it's still running. we're asking them to pause; will confirm in 2m.
Sasha M: quick mitigation options: 1) temporary pool weight bump on their dedicated pool 2) emergency contract exception (rate override) 3) route heavy traffic to aux-hosted fallback model (expensive). prefer 1+2. thoughts?
Priya R: agree 1+2. plan: bump pool weight 2x for 15m and apply override to 3x baseline for 30m. revert early if no improvement or if other tenants are impacted.
Charlie W: engineers — here's the cURL we use to trigger the override (runbook proven):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood/api/v1/contracts/override" \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
 -d '{"customer":"ridgeway","duration_min":30,"multiplier":3,"reason":"emergency unthrottle - 429 spike"}'
```
OpsBot: Action logged: contract-override request queued (id: co-2026-991). Auto-approval policy requires two approvers.
Sasha M: approving + setting pool weight now. infractl command: 
```bash
infractl pool update vpc-pool-ridgeway-01 --weight 2 --expiry 900
```
Lee T: also toggled kv-cache-prefetch for that tenant to reduce cold miss rate. monitoring tail latency and eviction rates.
OpsBot: infractl: pool vpc-pool-ridgeway-01 weight set -> 2 (expiry 900s).
Sasha M: approved override. administering now. :white_check_mark:
Priya R: override active. early signal: 429s down from ~48% -> ~8% within 2m. CPU on pool still high but trending down. :thumbsup:
Charlie W: pushed note to ticketing: INC-2026-487 (capture actions + logs). please attach top caller list for postmortem.
Ridgeway Support: update from customer — they paused the job. they will run a warmup and throttle retries on their side. thanks for the quick action.
Lee T: leaving a quick post-ops checklist: - capture top callers and request payload shapes - sample model context lengths - KV eviction timeline - recommend longer-term burst profile for this tenant
Sasha M: will monitor for 30m and then revert if stable. if retries or 429 tail >5% we escalate to SRE incident. reopening channel if symptoms return. :eyes:
OpsBot: Incident note appended to INC-2026-487. timeline updated.
Sasha M: 30m check: system stable, 429s at ~1.2%. removing override + reverting pool weight to baseline. will leave monitoring in place and assign postmortem to eng-sre.
Charlie W: postmortem ticket created and assigned to eng-ml + eng-runtime for follow-up.
Priya R: thanks team. final action: confirm billing/contract change logs and record the emergency exception window.
Sasha M: closing active paging. keeping thread for follow-up notes. good work everyone. :tada:
